title: Classical Lexical Test Data: Latin Dictionary Inputs
description: A frozen Wiktionary-derived Latin dictionary input collection for compatibility, regression and stress testing. Each UTF-8 line is an equal lookup input, not an expected linguistic answer. Includes original, simple, teaching and special-character datasets, source attribution, manifests, checksums and reproducible standard-library Python builders. Lexical content: English Wiktionary contributors via Kaikki / Wiktextract (Tatu Ylonen and contributors). Selection and transformation: Xinjie Fang, Classical Cat Digital Humanities Lab. Data and documentation are CC BY-SA 4.0; original tools and tests are AGPL-3.0-only. Coverage is bounded by the captured source; no exhaustive historical-Latin coverage is claimed.
